scope: Additive primary-source confirmation of Vampstache L1-18 DPS bonuses; passive healing and attack-speed combat contracts remain partial.
game_version: Supercell 2025-01-22 announcement for the February 2025 update; September 2026 secondary page claims client build 18.600.3. Exact current executable and effect order are unverified.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese table prints before-and-after DPS bonuses for each Vampstache level; all 18 post-buff values match the retained normalized records.
sources.limitations: It does not print heal-per-hit, attack-speed increase, healing event, cadence arithmetic or modifier stacking.

sources.title: Vampstache — Clash of Clans Wiki
facts: The page claims client build 18.600.3 and prints the same DPS sequence as the official 2025 post-buff table.
sources.limitations: The page does not expose healing amounts, attack-speed increase or attack event semantics.

derivations.result: All 18 retained DPS bonuses have direct Supercell numeric corroboration and a dated September 2026 secondary match.
derivations.method: Transcribe only the official post-buff DPS column, compare every level with the immutable normalized catalogue and the reported 18.600.3 page; do not infer heal or speed values.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the historical healPerHit and attackSpeedIncrease fields as current
rejected_inferences.reason: Neither dated level table displays those fields.

rejected_inferences.rule: Convert bonus DPS directly to bonus damage per hit
rejected_inferences.reason: The table omits attack cadence, rounding and interaction with the separate attack-speed bonus.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal on every successful damage impact or at attack launch
rejected_inferences.reason: The official each-attack description does not identify the phase, target eligibility or zero-damage behavior.
Healing value and event order, speed conversion and two-Equipment stacking remain unsourced.

items: attack launch, hit or damage-impact heal trigger and target eligibility
heal cap, damage/death ordering and multi-target impact behavior
DPS-to-hit and speed-to-cadence conversion, rounding and two-Equipment stacking
Viewer effect overlay, future-influencing snapshot and replay state, RL access

conclusion: The retained Vampstache L1-18 DPS bonus series has direct primary numeric evidence and a dated current-build claim. Healing and attack-speed combat behavior remain partial, and no Equipment effect is enabled.
